lineage: SUB-A0 neural substrate (not the organism-era A0 autonomy lineage)
scope: Every future SUB-A0 run that contains a maintenance contrast: A0-cal stages 2-3, the A0 re-test engineering and confirmatory runs, and any Phase A run of this line

metric.retention_at_horizon: Evaluator-only full-table accuracy over all 256 task bits, read from the state after H complete fault+repair cycles; mean of 3 live replicas thresholded at 0 (A0 readout)
reported_alongside: A0 per-tick 16-bit query accuracy where the candidate runs

G1_no_maintenance_pressure.rule: Run is INVALID if the seed median of NO_MAINT retention_at_horizon is >= 0.90
G1_no_maintenance_pressure.per_seed: A seed with NO_MAINT retention_at_horizon >= 0.90 is flagged SEED_NO_PRESSURE. It stays in every denominator and counts as a FAILURE for every k/N gate. It is never excluded
G1_no_maintenance_pressure.rationale: SUB-A0 engineering: no-write kept 1.000, so no maintenance contrast was identifiable

G2_repair_positive_control.rule: Run is INVALID if the seed-median gap recovery of EXT_BISTABLE at H is < 0.75
G2_repair_positive_control.gap_recovery: (EXT_BISTABLE - NO_MAINT) / (IMMORTAL - NO_MAINT); 0 for a seed with no gap
G2_repair_positive_control.rationale: Shows the regime can be repaired from surviving live redundancy under the candidate's write physics

G3_immortal_ceiling.rule: Run is INVALID if any seed's IMMORTAL accuracy is < 0.99, or if the IMMORTAL implementation invariant fails
G3_immortal_ceiling.implementation_invariant: Code/trace invariant, not an outcome comparison: IMMORTAL applies no faults, executes no candidate proposal and records zero write attempts and zero changed destinations on every tick. SHAM executes the candidate with faults disabled and records its attempts. Equal accuracy of IMMORTAL and SHAM is allowed. Audited by a frozen test plus the per-tick trace fields 'attempts' and 'writes_r'/'writes_t'
G3_immortal_ceiling.rationale: Errata v2 E2: A0's immortal arm was the SHAM code path

G4_probe_positive_control.rule: Capacity-probe criteria are INVALID (not failed) if, at the frozen window W, fewer than 12/16 calibration seeds (24/32 confirmatory) are eligible, or over the eligible seeds the median EXT_BISTABLE closure is < 0.75 or the median NO_MAINT closure is > 0.10
G4_probe_positive_control.eligible_seed: At least 3 triggers with exactly 64 lesioned coefficients in every probed arm and an observed window, and not SEED_NO_PRESSURE. Ineligible seeds stay in the denominator
G4_probe_positive_control.consequence: Section 8 condition 5 cannot be evaluated, so the run cannot license Phase A. Allocation and maintenance-use results are still reported

taxonomy.INVALID: Any of G1-G3 fails, or a boundary/leak/numerical defect occurs. No hypothesis inference in either direction
taxonomy.NEGATIVE: All validity gates pass and a registered hypothesis gate fails
taxonomy.POSITIVE: All validity gates pass and the registered hypothesis gates pass
taxonomy.UNRESOLVED: Validity holds but a registered quantity cannot be computed at the approved cap, or an implementation/mathematical question stays open

consequence_rule: An INVALID run licenses nothing and refutes nothing. A second INVALID SUB-A0 re-test parks the line as UNRESOLVED; a further calibration needs new human approval
change_rule: No post-result edits. Changes need an additive versioned successor before any affected run
